c.t:
Cyst > 10 HU, thickened pericardium,
fluid > 50 mL, or calcification

note: Normal pericardium is 1–2 mm thick; > 3–4 mm is abnormal. Up to 50 mL of fluid can be physiologic. * Benign, but may need resection if large and affecting cardiac function. † E.g. autoimmune disease, prior radiation or infection, renal disease, medications. ‡ Consider pericarditis, post-infarction, metabolic (hypothyroid, uraemic), autoimmune disease, sarcoidosis.
cite: Munden RF et al. Managing Incidental Findings on Thoracic CT: Mediastinal and Cardiovascular Findings. A White Paper of the ACR Incidental Findings Committee. J Am Coll Radiol. 2018;15(8):1087-1096.
